# Workflow Console

A 46.8-second release-automation film in navy and ice blue: a typed title, a command that types itself, terminal runs with tool calls, an environment carousel of node diagrams, a rollout response, pipeline metrics, a large recommendation with a camera push, a performance bar chart and a closing node mark. Silent: sound is added by the host. Commands, logs and metrics are fictional sample text.

Category: templates. Length: 46.833 s. WebGL: no.

Use when:
- You want a complete 46.8-second CLI or automation demo with editable commands and results.
- Your story moves from a natural-language request to execution, analysis, and improvement.

Avoid when:
- You only need one scrolling command: use terminal-cursor-zoom.
- You want a photographic product montage: use launch-anything.

Variables:
- prefix (string): Title prefix, default "Meet"
- product_name (string): Product name, default "Workflow Console"
- command (string): Opening command, default "prepare release v2.4. check the build, run tests in staging, then roll out with a canary."
- fetching (string): Loading line, default "Reading release context"
- launch_command (string): Launch command, default "Ship it."
- geography (string): Environment prompt, default "Choose an environment"
- campaign (string): Release name, default "Release v2.4"
- delivery (string): Delivery verb, default "rolling out"
- delivery_detail (string): Delivery detail, default "checks are PASSING, rollback is READY"
- growth (string): Growth title, default "Less waiting. More shipping."
- stats_loading (string): Metrics loading line, default "Reading pipeline metrics"
- stats_question (string): Metrics question, default "how is the pipeline doing?"
- followup (string): Follow-up question, default "where is the bottleneck?"
- change_command (string): Change command, default "What should we improve?"
- recommendation (string): Recommendation, default "The test queue is growing \u2014 add parallel workers."
- budget_label (string): Budget label, default "Test workers"
- old_budget (string): Old budget, default "2"
- new_budget (string): New budget, default "6"
- double_command (string): Scale command, default "scale to six workers"
- closing (string): Closing title, default "Keep your work moving"
- terminal_title (string): Terminal title, default "workflow\u3000~/releases/v2.4"
- chart_title (string): Chart title, default "Pipeline throughput \u00b7 demo runs / hour"
- env_1 (string): Environment 1, default "Preview"
- env_2 (string): Environment 2, default "Staging"
- env_3 (string): Environment 3, default "Production"
- env_4 (string): Environment 4, default "Canary"
- tool_log (string): Tool log, default "Workflow Read Release Plan\nChecked in 1.1s\nWorkflow Run Test Suite\nChecked in 1.9s\nWorkflow Create Canary\nWorkflow Start Rollout\nChecked in 0.1s"
- bar_1_label (string): Bar 1 label, default "Baseline"
- bar_1_value (number, 0-1000): Bar 1 value, default 24
- bar_1_detail (string): Bar 1 detail, default "24 runs / h"
- bar_2_label (string): Bar 2 label, default "Cache"
- bar_2_value (number, 0-1000): Bar 2 value, default 48
- bar_2_detail (string): Bar 2 detail, default "48 runs / h"
- bar_3_label (string): Bar 3 label, default "Parallel"
- bar_3_value (number, 0-1000): Bar 3 value, default 72
- bar_3_detail (string): Bar 3 detail, default "72 runs / h"
- bar_4_label (string): Bar 4 label, default "Optimized"
- bar_4_value (number, 0-1000): Bar 4 value, default 96
- bar_4_detail (string): Bar 4 detail, default "96 runs / h"
- terminal_campaign (string): Terminal rows, first run, default ""
- terminal_launched (string): Terminal rows, second run, default ""
- terminal_stats (string): Terminal rows, third run, default ""
- accent_color (color): Accent, default "#8ed8f8"
- background_color (color): Background, default "#0e1b2b"
- logo_src (string): Logo image, default ""
